summary: Iteration 44 - Cross-device settings persistence + post-ride adaptation auto-refresh with 'plan updated' nudge. BACKEND (8/8 pytest pass - /app/backend/tests/test_iter44_settings_adaptation.py): (1) NEW user-scoped rider settings: GET /api/rider/settings returns a dict (initially {} for a fresh account). PUT /api/rider/settings with partial body {seatedMode:true, hasTrainer:true} returns the merged doc; subsequent GET reflects both. A further PUT {hudEnabled:false} merges without disturbing prior keys. User-scoping verified end-to-end: a freshly registered temp account sees settings with seatedMode/hasTrainer both False, i.e. no leakage from GL's document. After testing, PUT restored {seatedMode:false, hasTrainer:false, hudEnabled:true}. (2) Coaching prefs persistence: PUT /api/rider/prefs {coach_style:'performance'} returns coach_style='performance'; GET confirms; then restored to 'balanced'. (3) Auto-refresh adaptation after a ride: primed a baseline via POST /api/coach/adaptation/detail, then POST /api/coach/debrief with {workout:'Endurance Ride', duration_sec:1800, avg_power:150, tss:40, compliance:98, coach_name:'Alberto', coach_gender:'male', intervals:[]} returned 200. Polled GET /api/plan for up to 24s and observed the timestamp advance - the plan now surfaces a fresh adaptation_ai_alberto_at (and adaptation_detail_alberto_at is also present when checked). (4) GET /api/plan reliably includes both timestamps after the background refresh. FRONTEND (landscape 1024x720, real GL login via testID email-input/password-input/submit-btn): (5) Today (/) - after debrief triggered a fresh timestamp and localStorage seen-key cleared, the plan-updated-nudge appears at the TOP of the main scroll (y=~24) ABOVE the hero (y=~87). Copy reads 'Alberto updated your plan' + 'Fresh guidance based on your last ride'. Tapping the nudge (or its 'View' area) navigates to /plan; returning to Today shows NO nudge (markPlanSeen wrote the timestamp). Separately, the plan-updated-nudge-dismiss ('x') hides the nudge without navigation (URL unchanged). (6) Settings persistence: tested via /connections Smart Trainer toggle (device-btn-trainer) since /settings does not expose Seated Mode / Smart Trainer directly - toggling ON hits PUT /api/rider/settings ({hasTrainer:true}), navigating to Today and back retains 'Disconnect' state; even after localStorage 'roujaune:settings' is cleared and the page reloaded, the server re-hydrates hasTrainer=true. Toggled back to OFF for cleanup. Final GL state verified pristine: coach_id=alberto, coach_style=balanced, seatedMode=false, hasTrainer=false, hudEnabled=true.

issues: Review request said 'toggle a setting (e.g., Seated Mode or Smart Trainer) on /settings' but neither Seated Mode nor Smart Trainer toggles exist on the /settings screen — Smart Trainer lives on /connections (device-btn-trainer) and Seated Mode is only in the pre-ride sheet inside /workout. Persistence was verified via the /connections Smart Trainer toggle instead; the underlying /api/rider/settings storage is shared, so behaviour is equivalent. Consider surfacing at least the Seated Mode toggle on /settings if the review wording is prescriptive.

action_items: Optional (spec alignment): if the intent is that Seated Mode or Smart Trainer live on /settings (not /connections), add those toggles to /app/frontend/app/settings.tsx. Persistence layer already supports them via useSettings -> PUT /api/rider/settings.
No functional issues to fix — both features (server-scoped preferences persistence + post-ride adaptation nudge) work end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_rider_settings (~line 1126) correctly returns {} when no doc exists (fresh accounts), strips _id and user_id from output. update_rider_settings (~line 1136) safely blacklists id/user_id/_id in the merge patch and upserts with $set, ensuring the user_id auto-injected by _ScopedCollection stays intact.

server.py _refresh_adaptation_after_ride (~line 1785) writes adaptation_ai_<coach>+_at synchronously against training_plans, then regenerates adaptation_detail_<coach>+_at in a best-effort block. Both timestamps land under the user-scoped training_plans doc and are surfaced by _with_adaptation_meta on GET /api/plan.
server.py _with_adaptation_meta (~line 2590) only overlays timestamp keys when the training_plans doc has them, keeping the /plan response free of nulls when no debrief has run yet.

PlanUpdatedNudge.tsx: dismiss button correctly stops propagation via a nested Pressable — the outer nudge Pressable's onPress fires only when the row body is tapped, verified by observing URL remained on / after tapping x. Also renders BEFORE <View style={styles.heroRow}> in app/index.tsx (line 110 before line 112), so it visually sits above the hero as required.

plan-badge.ts: usePlanBadge picks the max of adaptation_ai_alberto_at / adaptation_ai_adriana_at via sort+pop, then compares to the SEEN_KEY in AsyncStorage — clean and simple. Note: refreshPlanBadge fetches /api/plan without an Authorization header (relies on cookies/session in web / AsyncStorage bearer via fetch interceptor elsewhere); on native this will fail silently and the badge won't fire. In web preview it worked because the app-scaffold-level auth already installs the token — worth verifying on device.

settings.ts useSettings correctly hydrates in order: (1) local AsyncStorage cache -> immediate UI, (2) fetchRemoteSettings -> merge over cache and persist merged cache, (3) if ftpAuto, fetch progress FTP. This gives instant-load + cross-device correctness.
